threads.body: `getStableOperationName(..)` currently treats `batchSize == 0` (which is returned when the request is missing/doesn’t expose `RequestItems`, or when it’s empty) as a single-item request and maps `Batch*` operations to `GetItem`/`WriteItem`. That can mis-label real batch requests whenever batch size extraction fails, and it also mislabels empty batch requests. Only down-convert to the item operation when the extracted size is exactly 1; otherwise keep the batch operation name and just omit `db.operation.batch.size` when unknown.

threads.body: `getStableOperationName(..)` treats `batchSize == null` (returned when `RequestItems` can’t be accessed or when the computed count is 0) as a single-item request and maps `Batch*` operations to `GetItem`/`WriteItem`. If batch size extraction fails for a real multi-item batch, this will emit an incorrect stable operation name. Only emit the item operation name when the extracted size is exactly 1; otherwise keep the batch operation name and omit `db.operation.batch.size` when unknown.

replies.body: No code change needed. The v1.11 extractor already uses the same isBatch(batchSize) predicate for stable operation naming and db.operation.batch.size emission, matching the JDBC/Cassandra precedent.

threads.body: The updated extractor logic changes stable semconv behavior for `BatchWriteItem` (including `db.operation.name` mapping to `WriteItem` vs `BATCH WriteItem`, and `db.operation.batch.size` emission), but the v1.11 test suite here only exercises `BatchGetItem`. Adding coverage for `BatchWriteItem` (single-item and multi-item) would prevent regressions and validate the new behavior matches the intended semantics.

threads.body: `getStableOperationName(..)` currently down-converts `BatchGetItem`/`BatchWriteItem` to `GetItem`/`WriteItem` whenever `batchSize` is not a batch (<= 1). Since `extractBatchSize(..)` can return `null` (unknown) or `0` (e.g., if the `Keys` accessor lookup fails or the request is empty), this can mis-label true batch operations as single-item operations. The stable operation name should only be down-converted when the extracted size is exactly 1; otherwise keep the `BATCH …` operation name and just omit `db.operation.batch.size` when the size is unknown/unavailable.

Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/e7aada3fdadac522e4cdb7604662a5590b94d74e.

Unknown or zero batch sizes now keep the raw BatchGetItem/BatchWriteItem operation name, exact size one maps to GetItem/WriteItem, and only size greater than one maps to BATCH ... and emits db.operation.batch.size.
